segments.title: Hype Train Freestyle & Subscriber Milestone
segments.notes: Pepito delivers cold open as 'Papita'; Hype Train performs extended freestyle rap over trap beats while acknowledging Level 3 hype train, 16-month and 20-month subscribers, and approaching two-year stream anniversary.

segments.title: Sean 'Diddy' Combs Federal Indictment Coverage
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and Tyler discuss unsealed three-count indictment charging Combs with racketeering conspiracy, sex trafficking, and interstate transportation for prostitution; details include hidden cameras, 700+ dildos, 'freak off' parties, employee facilitation, and celebrity reactions including 50 Cent and Charlemagne the God.

segments.title: Bubba Sparks Interview: Quiznos Employee & Virginity Claims
segments.notes: Case interviews early-2000s rapper Bubba Sparks, who reveals he now works at Quiznos, partied with the Quiznos 'rat creatures' in 2007, claims to be a virgin who has never seen genitalia, and denies attending any Diddy parties.

segments.title: Jeb's Kitchen: Cream of Mushroom Soup, Microwave Pepper, Air Fryer S'mores, Frozen Salad
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget hosts cooking segment from woodshop with father's spirit in wooden board; features Greg's Kitchen cream of mushroom soup, microwaved stuffed red pepper, air fryer chocolate marshmallows, and a frozen vegetable salad; Kendelle walks through studio; Jeb's Dad cannot recall his own death (trash/shed incident).

segments.title: Grower vs Shower Debate
segments.notes: Munch argues for 'shower' (truth in advertising); Crum argues for 'grower' (spectacle/Blitzkrieg); chat prediction market awards 73k channel points to nine viewers who backed Munch; Crum's head compared to worn-down eraser.

segments.title: Who Is Stuck in P. Diddy's Closet?
segments.notes: Panel of Liliana, Grandma Crumble Bottom, Tyler, and Chet interrogated about Diddy party attendance, Cambodian breast milk cookies (Chappelle Show reference), Bruno (Encanto reference), and dildo limits; chat poll concludes Grandma Crumble Bottom is the one hiding in the closet; she claims virginity with 'closet kids.'

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid to Bricky
segments.notes: Case bumps Joe Rogan segment to Friday; Grandma Crumble Bottom accidentally routes exit through DNC feed; Case raids Bricky's channel after plugging Patreon.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored Diddy indictment coverage, interviewed Bubba Sparks, moderated Munch & Crum grower/shower debate and Jambalaya closet panel, debuted new gold jacket.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open as 'Papita' (ASR garble), managed Hype Train audio levels and Panther beat cues.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: Performed extended freestyle rap over trap beats during Level 3 hype train, acknowledged 16-month and 20-month subscribers, approached two-year stream anniversary.

characters.name: Tyler
characters.notes: call-in guest. Co-hosted News desk for Diddy coverage, appeared on Jambalaya panel, discussed SimCity city Rennerton and Quiznos rat parties.

characters.name: Bubba Sparks
characters.notes: guest. Early-2000s rapper interviewed live; revealed he works at Quiznos, partied with Quiznos mascots in 2007, claims virginity and no Diddy party attendance.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: correspondent. Hosted How To cooking segment from woodshop with father's spirit; demonstrated cream of mushroom soup, microwave pepper, air fryer s'mores, frozen salad; cannot recall own death.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: co-host (spirit). Deceased father trapped in wooden board; bickered with Jeb, claimed 24/7 spiritual sex with wood nymph, cannot remember dying after taking trash to shed.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walked through studio during How To segment; greeted by Case and Jeb as 'wood nymph.'

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Jambalaya panelist; admitted attending Diddy parties but found them 'desperate,' refused to discuss Bruno, set no limit on responsible dildo ownership.

characters.name: Grandma Crumble Bottom
characters.notes: recurring. Jambalaya panelist; claimed never owned a closet, endorsed breast milk cookies when out of milk, declared one dildo too many, revealed virginity with 'closet kids,' chat voted her as the one in Diddy's closet.

characters.name: Chet
characters.notes: correspondent. Jambalaya panelist; denied ever attending Diddy parties citing moral character, answered 'negative' to party attendance.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued 'shower' position in grower vs shower debate (truth in advertising), won chat prediction market, mocked Crum's head as worn-down eraser.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued 'grower' position (Blitzkrieg spectacle), lost chat prediction market, head compared to worn-down eraser by Munch.

storylines.beat: [1:21:00] Case references Beyblade points on channel point border (~10 points) during Jambalaya setup, confirming community pledge tracker still active.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell debuted a new gold jacket/coat for the stream's approaching two-year anniversary.
Bubba Sparks now works at Quiznos making sandwiches (classic Italian, honey bacon club, spicy maran).
Bubba Sparks claims to be a virgin who has never had sex and has never seen a vagina or his own penis.
Jeb's Dad (spirit in wooden board) cannot remember how he died; recalls taking trash out three times, then shed trash, then noticing neighbors' trash cans before waking up in the wood.
Grandma Crumble Bottom claims to be a virgin despite having children, referring to them as 'closet kids.'
Grandma Crumble Bottom believes Joe Diddly (radio host) is the greatest blues man, confuses him with Sammy Davis Jr.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell covers the federal sex trafficking and racketeering indictment of Sean 'Diddy' Combs with co-host Tyler, then interviews rapper Bubba Sparks who reveals he works at Quiznos and claims lifelong virginity. Jeb Nogget hosts a How To cooking segment from his woodshop featuring cream of mushroom soup and air fryer s'mores while his deceased father's spirit bickers from a wooden board. Munch and Crum debate 'grower vs shower' with chat prediction markets, and a Jambalaya panel including Liliana, Grandma Crumble Bottom, Tyler, and Chet investigates who is hiding in Diddy's closet — chat votes Grandma Crumble Bottom.
